channel: l1-zkevm/_threads/Can someone give me the geth witness of
searchText: I have a node polling for execution witness, but just looked into it now and got RPC 500 status errors so unfortunately have a gap for that block. I'm currently investigating missing data in reth witness. Any know issues? in my case a target of BALANCE is missing in witness.keys cc <@774033563732541451> <@427491045308235776> No keys in the new witness format? The things I found in Reth witness generation were mostly more things than needed added to `state` and `codes` fields. Yeah we don't have `keys` field in the spec format since technically isn't needed in a canonical execution witness. What is "canonical execution witness"? And why reth format needs keys? > canonical execution witness" Its a minimal execution witness essentially > And why reth format needs keys I don't think it was used, you can use it to do all of the state checks upfront We do use it. But I'm not witness expert. what do you use it for? Ethrex also used it, though they are making a small change to remove it Isn't using hashed keys bad from the start? It turned out, our RPC provider switched reth to geth. Do you have any reth endpoint to check? We've access to a Reth one from pandaops -- but it is currently replying to me 503 status codes. Asked Barnabas to see if might have a problem. Reth only realistically allows querying for blocks around ~25 blocks from the tip... older ones take a lot of time due to state rewind and usually the RPC fails. So querying for 24640436 wouldn't be possible (i think that's the check you wanted?) It turns out this reth, just says its geth 🙂 I'm trying to understand all details at once but I should be fine.
